2027 zodiac animals who may want to slow down in relationships 🐑

1. Rat (born 1972, 1984, 1996)
2. Ox (1973, 1985, 1997)
3. Dog (1982, 1994, 2006)

In Saju they 'harm', 'clash' or 'punish' the Goat. Not bad luck — just a year to listen first, talk second.

(Born before early Feb? You may be the animal before.) Yours? Reply 'me!' 🌙
